{{Quote|It is fairly easy for me to transfer a memnis to another member of the Kla clan or to my father's clan, the A clan.|Elegos A'Kla|<ref name="Jedi" />}}
The '''A''' was a clan of the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the paternal clan of<ref name="Jedi" /> a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]],<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> [[Elegos A'Kla]]. [[Elegos A'Kla's father|A'Kla's father]], a member of the A clan, mated with a [[Elegos A'Kla's mother|female]] of the [[Kla (clan)|Kla]] clan, resulting in his [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]]. As a result, A'Kla could transfer [[Memnis|''memnii'']], important memories experienced by a Caamasi that could be shared with other Caamasi, to members of the A clan with relative ease. A'Kla mentioned his father's clan when speaking with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
A was mentioned in ''[[I, Jedi]]'', a novel by [[Michael A. Stackpole]] that was first published in [[1998]].<ref name="Jedi" />
